label: ETV6::RUNX1

sections.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.
RUNX1 encodes the DNA-binding alpha subunit of core-binding factor, a regulator of hematopoiesis.

The cryptic t(12;21) fusion combines ETV6 repressive activity with RUNX1 DNA-binding regions and perturbs B-cell differentiation. It is a common initiating lesion in childhood B-ALL and can arise prenatally.
ETV6::RUNX1-positive childhood B-ALL generally has favorable outcomes with contemporary chemotherapy, although late relapse occurs.
